description: Restructure the email configuration documentation to improve clarity and organization. Consolidate email-related configuration information that's currently scattered across multiple documentation pages into a more logical structure. This will help users find and understand email setup instructions more easily.
functional_requirements: Create a consolidated email configuration section that brings together all email-related settings
Remove duplicate or overlapping email configuration information from multiple documentation pages
Ensure the restructured documentation maintains all existing technical content while improving organization
Update cross-references and navigation to point to the new consolidated email documentation
Maintain backward compatibility for any existing documentation links that might be bookmarked
